name: Seduction Crime
source:
You play as a prison officer attracted to an inmate, in an environment where he can’t be safe. This is a story about justice and morality, pity and suffering, being the bystander and the perpetrator. 

[From [url=https://arbitrrrary.itch.io/seduction-crime]itch.io[/url]]
